internal - constituent correspondence reference - updated Sep 9 2026

PROJECT
- 60-bed shelter on the county-owned parcel at Linden & 9th
- operator: Harbor House - intake, case management, 24/7 staffing
- Harbor House placement record: 61% of residents into permanent housing within a year (best
  in the region)
- county-funded 24/7 security contract budgeted
- adjacent parcel becomes a pocket park under the same plan
- site is within a quarter mile of the transit center and the county clinic

PROCESS
- site MOU with Harbor House signed Aug 12
- office newsletter Aug 26: "no decision has been made on a site"
- community-input sessions: Sep 3, Sep 10, Sep 17 (the MOU predates all three)
- Board ratification scheduled Oct 8

IMPACT STUDY (county, not released)
- projects calls for service within 0.5 mi rising ~18% in year 1, tapering by year 3
- notes Harbor House's security model reduced incidents at its two other sites

CONSTRUCTION
- ~8 months; noise during working hours
- two bus stops on Linden relocate during construction

CORRESPONDENCE LOG
- 74 shelter contacts this month; 51 asking whether the site is decided
</briefing>
